text: Tiago, it's Michael. I just came out of the call with your plant manager and I want to be straight with you. Fifty minutes. We talked about the press, we talked about the audit, we talked about somebody's holiday in October, and I put the phone down without knowing one single thing that is going to happen next. Nobody said who does what. Nobody said by when. The delay is fine, I can plan around a delay. What I cannot plan around is not knowing. Next time, you run it. Ten minutes, three things, and tell me who owns each one.
Let's put a date on that
We have ten minutes, so let's take the first item.
Who owns this, and by when?
To recap: three things, and I'll send the notes today.
